usage: 親戚 refers to relatives or extended family members outside the immediate family.
It can refer to one relative or multiple relatives depending on the context.
The word is often used when talking about family gatherings, visits, or family relationships.
親戚 is commonly used with expressions like 探親戚 (visit relatives) or 啲親戚 (some relatives).
It can also refer more broadly to family connections through blood or marriage.
